map.宽带带宽按人数与用途推荐：1 至 2 人日常上网 50 至 100 Mbps、3: Broadband bandwidth is recommended by number of users and usage: 1–2 people daily surfing 50–100 Mbps, 3–4 people multi-device and HD video 200–300 Mbps, 4+ people or 4K and gaming 500–1000 Mbps; actual usable bandwidth ≈ nominal bandwidth × (1 − line loss 10%–20%) ÷ simultaneously online devices; equipment essentials include gigabit optical modem, WiFi 6 dual-band router (2.4G and 5G) and Cat-5e or better cable; before installation verify whether the community is already covered.
map.📚 深度解析：宽带带宽与安装要点速查: 📚 Deep Dive: Broadband Bandwidth and Installation Quick Reference
map.租房或搬家前快速列出几种典型用网场景对应的带宽档位与接入方式，作为选购对照。: Before renting or moving, quickly list the bandwidth tiers and access methods for several typical network scenarios, as a purchase reference.
map.和运营商沟通前先看一遍常见安装注意项（光猫押金、合约期、违约金、高峰期稳定性）。: Before talking to the operator, review common installation notes (modem deposit, contract period, early-termination penalty, peak-hour stability).
map.给合租室友或家人解释为什么需要某个档位，用场景而不是参数沟通。: Explain to co-tenants or family why a certain tier is needed, communicating by scenario rather than parameters.
map.生成结果长什么样: What does the generated result look like
map.设定生成数量后，工具逐条输出\"使用场景 — 推荐带宽 + 接入类型\"并附一条: After setting the generation count, the tool outputs line by line "usage scenario — recommended bandwidth + access type" with one installation tip, e.g. "home remote work — recommended 500M fiber to the home (FTTH) / installation tip: watch the contract period and early-termination penalty". Scenarios, bandwidth tiers, access types and tips are all sampled from common combinations, so the same setting generates different entries each time.
map.为什么没有让我输入人数和户型？: Why does it not ask me to enter the number of users and unit type?
map.本工具是速查清单，只按你设定的条数从常见场景组合中取样，不做按人数/面积的带宽推: This tool is a quick-reference list; it only samples from common scenario combinations by the count you set, and does not compute bandwidth by number of users/area. When you need a precise estimate by device count, accumulate yourself per "about 25 Mbps per 4K stream, about 4 Mbps per video conference".
map.推荐结果能当运营商报价吗？: Can the recommendation be used as an operator quote?
map.不能。它不包含任何实时资费与覆盖信息，仅用于对照选购；实际套餐价格、安装费与覆盖: No. It contains no real-time tariff or coverage information, and is for purchase comparison only; for actual plan prices, installation fees and coverage, please refer to your local operator.
